description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targeted” or “Untargeted” across the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, and the vertical axis represents “Number of datasets,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at 20-unit intervals. For each year, there are two bars displayed side-by-side: a blue bar representing “Targeted” datasets and an orange bar representing “Untargeted” datasets, as indicated by the legend. In 2012, both the “Targeted” and “Untargeted” bars are minimal, reaching approximately 1 and 0 datasets respectively. The “Targeted” bar increases to a value of approximately 68 in 2018, while the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 44. In 2022, the “Targeted” bar reaches the highest value at approximately 156 datasets, and the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 31 datasets. The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized.
